title: Staged rollout: enable provision-to-ready automation for Dedicated pools (us-east / A100 only)
creator: Talia Benson
description:
Operational ticket to run the first staged rollout of the provision-to-ready automation pipeline.

Rollout constraints (must hold)
- Region: us-east only
- GPU type: A100 only (Dedicated pools)
- New nodes only (do not retroactively gate existing Ready nodes)
- Kill switch must be verified before enabling

Primary goal
- Validate the end-to-end workflow (Allocated → Provisioning → Validating → Ready) and ensure the gating logic + quarantine policy does not create unacceptable capacity shortfalls.

Non-goals
- Expanding to other regions/GPU types
- Tightening thresholds beyond the agreed initial defaults (tuning goes in ENG-4830)

Related implementation artifacts
- Feature flag / staged rollout toggles: sources/github/redwood/pr-18433-add-feature-flag-for-staged-provisioning-rollout.json
- Terraform rollout variables: sources/github/redwood-terraform/pr-399-add-staged-rollout-variables-by-region.json
- Validation agent DaemonSet: sources/github/redwood-helm-charts/pr-244-add-node-validation-agent-daemonset.json
- Metrics/tracing spans: sources/github/redwood/pr-18441-emit-provision-to-ready-metrics-step-breakdown.json
- Perf/inference smoke canary: sources/github/perf-canary/pr-177-add-post-provision-smoke-canary-for-dedicated-pools.json
- Readiness gate before joining serving pools: sources/github/redwood/pr-18496-add-readiness-gate-before-adding-nodes-to-serving-pools.json
- Dashboards/alerts pack: sources/github/observability-pack/pr-812-add-provision-to-ready-dashboards-and-alerts.json

Owners / roles
- Rollout owner: Harish Reddy (Infra/Fleet)
- Go/no-go approver (Fleet): Vanessa Ortiz
- Go/no-go approver (Platform): Ethan Park
- Go/no-go approver (SRE): Rafael Mendes (coverage) / Sean Gallagher (escalation)
- Dashboards/alerts: Aisha Bello
- Release coordination: Connor O'Brien

Rollout window
- Target: 2025-10-16 10:00–14:00 ET
- Backout window: same day (keep team online through 18:00 ET)

Change summary
- Enable staged provisioning automation + readiness gating for Dedicated us-east A100 pools only.
- Enforce: nodes cannot join serving pools until Ready.
- Quarantine after repeated validation failures (per ENG-4825 defaults).

Pre-flight checklist (must be GREEN before any flag enable)
1) Code + config readiness
   - [ ] Feature flag exists and is OFF in prod by default (verified)
   - [ ] Flag targeting supports region=us-east and gpu=a100 scoping
   - [ ] Terraform modules applied with rollout variables set for us-east/A100 only
   - [ ] Validation agent DaemonSet deployed to us-east clusters and reporting heartbeats
   - [ ] Readiness service API reachable from internal tooling and writes are audited

2) Observability readiness
   - [ ] Grafana dashboard for step breakdown is live and loads in <5s
   - [ ] Metrics cardinality validated (no per-node-id tags; pool_id only)
   - [ ] Alerts are in “ticket” mode for first 24h (paging gated by SRE)

3) Capacity / safety
   - [ ] Confirm Dedicated pool(s) have headroom to tolerate initial quarantine rate
   - [ ] Confirm rollback plan does not require image rebuild (flag-based preferred)

4) Comms
   - [ ] #eng-infra and #eng-sre notified 30 min prior
   - [ ] Support aware: potential short-lived readiness delays while validations run

Go/No-Go criteria (start of window)
GO if all are true:
- No active P0/P1 incidents in us-east Dedicated
- Dashboards green: error rate for provisioning pipeline < 2% over last 60m (baseline)
- Kill switch verified (dry-run) and rollback owner present
- SRE coverage confirmed for the window

NO-GO if any are true:
- Known image mismatch in us-east A100 channel (candidate vs stable confusion)
- Validation agent crashlooping > 2% of nodes
- Readiness state writes failing or delayed > 2m consistently

Rollout steps (operator runbook)
1) Enable flag for a single canary Dedicated pool (us-east / A100)
   - Target: 5–10 new nodes (or next scheduled expansion)
   - Monitor: time-to-ready per-node; failure reason distribution

2) Verify end-to-end
   - Expected: node transitions visible in readiness service within 60s of step completion
   - Expected: nodes join serving pool only after Ready (no Serving membership pre-Ready)

3) Expand to remaining us-east A100 Dedicated pools (still staged)
   - Increase flag scope to pool_class=dedicated AND gpu=a100 AND region=us-east

4) Hold and observe
   - Minimum observation: 2h after last node reaches Ready or Quarantined

Success metrics (for this rollout)
- Provision-to-ready P95 <= 90 minutes for us-east A100 (new nodes)
- End-to-end success rate >= 98% (Ready / (Ready + Quarantined)) over the window
- Quarantine rate <= 3% (initial thresholds); if higher, stop + investigate
- No customer-visible capacity shortfall attributable to gating/quarantine

Stop conditions (immediate)
- Quarantine rate > 8% over 30 minutes (or >3 nodes in a single pool within 30m)
- Any evidence nodes are joining serving pools before Ready
- Validation step failure mode appears systemic (same failure signature across >20% of nodes)
- Metrics cardinality regression / telemetry pipeline degradation

Rollback plan
Primary rollback (preferred)
- Disable feature flag for us-east/A100 scope (return to legacy join behavior)
Secondary rollback
- Disable readiness gate enforcement (if separate toggle exists) while keeping telemetry
Tertiary rollback
- Pause pool expansions and revert Terraform rollout variables to previous stable defaults

Post-rollout tasks (capture here; follow-ups go to ENG-4830)
- Summarize metrics: P50/P95 time-to-ready, top 3 failure modes, quarantine count by pool
- List any threshold tuning recommendations (timeouts, NCCL smoke test sensitivity)
- Confirm any new runbook entries needed based on real failures seen

Notes
- This rollout must be consistent with the quarantine policy draft: auto-quarantine after N repeated failures, operator override allowed, and safe remediation order is drain → quarantine → reimage (not the reverse).
